title: People Ops manager prep - Q1 2026
content:
Purpose:
- Notes for 1:1 with Priya (manager) — high level status, asks, blockers, calibration input, promotion/comp readiness.

High-level summary / narrative (1-2 lines):
- Q1 focused on stabilizing hiring velocity for infra and serving-runtime teams, getting onboarding checklist automated, and finalizing new comp bands. Early wins: reduced time-to-offer for IC hires from 14 -> 9 days for roles we own. Still blocked on vendor integration for background checks.

Goals (Q1 2026) — what I own:
- Reduce average time-to-offer for high-priority eng roles to <=10 days (current: 12 days across all teams; targeted roles at 9).
- Implement automated onboarding checklist + HRIS integration for new hires (MVP live by end of Feb).
- Launch pilot for manager enablement program (4 managers in pilot, focus: interview calibration + feedback).
- Deliver comp-band proposal to finance and get approval for mid-year salary adjustments.

Progress / evidence / data points:
- Hiring velocity: filled 6 critical roles (serving-runtime x3, platform-engineering x2, observability x1) in Jan. Funnel: 420 applicants -> 62 screened -> 16 onsites -> 6 offers accepted.
- Time-to-offer: averaged 9 days for roles owned; still seeing 18+ days for roles routed through external agency.
- Onboarding automation: checklist prototyped with HRIS API (work in progress). Automated otl emails + Slack welcome flow tested with two hires -> feedback positive, onboarding survey NPS +15.
- Manager enablement: curriculum drafted, content owners lined up (D&I + L&D co-build). Pilot cohort identified.
- Comp bands: modeled three scenarios (flat, targeted mid-year refresh, full-market realignment). Preferred: targeted refresh for critical IC tiers (eng L3-L5).

Examples / stories to surface in 1:1:
- Candidate X (serving-runtime) — passive outreach converted after tailored pitch on infra performance work; closed in 8 days. Shows value of proactive sourcing + hiring manager alignment.
- Onboarding glitch: new hire laptop provisioning delayed 48h due to vendor SKU mismatch — still need ops playbook + backup.

Asks for Priya (manager):
- Approval to convert two contractor sourcers to headcount for Q2 spike (data attached in Confluence). This will increase capacity by ~40% and should reduce agency spend.
- Support in prioritizing vendor review for background checks (we need procurement slot; this is blocking final offer step for remote hires in EU).
- Guidance on messaging for comp band pilot to managers — want a short 1-pager and a townhall; who should lead?

Blockers / risks:
- Procurement timeline for background checks (vendor integration delayed). Risk: losing candidates, lengthened time-to-offer.
- Budget uncertainty on mid-year comp refresh. If denied, need contingency plan for retention bonuses for critical folks.
- Engineering manager bandwidth for interview debriefs — causing slower decisions.

Calibration input / promotion readiness notes (people I own / coach):
- Casey Rivera (recruiter): performance strong, exceeded sourcing targets, ready for Sr Recruiter promotion discussion. Evidence: closed 18 hires in 2025 with 75% hiring manager satisfaction. Recommendation: promote to Sr, target promotion date 2026-04-01.
- Jordan Lee (HRBP): solid partner, needs work on stakeholder communications (missed a few alignment meetings). Suggested development plan: weekly sync with ENG TPM for next 6 weeks.

Self-reflection / areas I want feedback on:
- Stakeholder management: have I been proactive enough with cross-functional escalation? e.g., procurement delays — should I have owned escalation earlier?
- Prioritization: balancing operational hires vs strategic programs (manager enablement, onboarding automation). Am I spreading too thin?

Metrics I track (quick):
- Time-to-offer (median): 12 days -> target 10
- Offer acceptance rate: 78% (target >=80)
- New-hire 30-day satisfaction (survey): 4.2/5 -> target 4.5
- Open req backlog: 18 (critical: 6)
